description: Add a release to your site's public changelog (and its RSS feed). Give version and notes, or from_store=true to add the store listing's current version and What's new. Turns the changelog on if it's off.

date.description: Release date yyyy-mm-dd; today if left out.

from_store.description: true to take the version and notes from the store listing instead.

notes.description: What changed, one item per line.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: add_changelog_entry
title: Add a changelog entry
